params.name: BadgesContent
params.doc: Status chips (PkBadge) beside the title, after any Config badges.

params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { nav?: true|false|'auto', sections: [{ key?, bare?, heading, fields: [{ key, type, label, placeholder?, required?, options?, min?, max?, step? }] }] }. nav defaults to 'auto': a section list beside the cards from three sections (tabs on a phone); false keeps the plain stack.

params.name: Values
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: the current values keyed by field key.

params.name: Save
params.doc: Saves the values of the fields, keyed by field key (read text with GetString(), a switch with GetBoolean()). After a successful save the Values parameter becomes the saved values (JSON) and ValuesChanged is raised (@bind-Values). Throwing keeps the unsaved changes and shows the exception message; returning marks them saved.

params.name: SectionContent
params.doc: Your own content by section key (the Config section key): each shows inside that section's card after its fields, so the section nav and the save bar cover it. Controls in it that raise pk-value-change or pk-change mark the form changed; their values are not in Save's dictionary, keep them in your own state.

params.name: OnAction
params.note: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked; Key is its key.

notes: save(values) is a callback property, set from script (config is data, a callback is not): the generated component hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot) that calls the Save parameter.
